description: Translate source code comments and hover documentation with a local translation model (PLaMo 3 Translate + llama.cpp)
untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted workspaces, workspace settings cannot change the translation server endpoint or mode (so that your code is not sent to an unintended server).
config.translateDocumentation: Also translate the documentation that language servers show in hovers (descriptions of functions and classes).
config.inlineTranslation: Which comments show their translation to the right.
config.inlineTranslation.short: Line comments, trailing comments, and comments written on a single line
config.inlineTranslation.all: All comments, including multi-line blocks such as JSDoc
config.inlineMaxWidth: Approximate width of a line in columns, including the code and the translation to its right (full-width characters count as 2). Anything beyond it is truncated with "…" (hover to read the full text). Adjust it to the width of your editor.
config.server.mode: How the translation server is provided. If not set, it works as `external` when `interlinear.endpoint` is set.
config.server.mode.managed: The extension starts and manages the translation server (llama-server). The model is downloaded on first use
config.server.mode.external: Use a server you started yourself, specified by interlinear.endpoint
config.server.model: Translation model used in `managed` mode. If you choose a model that has not been downloaded, download it with the command "Interlinear: Set Up Translation Model".
config.server.model.0.8b: 0.8B (0.6 GB). Lightweight. For machines without a GPU
config.server.model.8b: 8B (5.3 GB). High quality, but about 3 times slower
config.server.idleTimeoutMinutes: In `managed` mode, minutes of inactivity before the translation server is stopped. Stopping frees the memory used by the model; the next use takes a few seconds to start it again. 0 means never stop.
config.server.llamaServerPath: Path to the llama-server used in `managed` mode. If empty, the automatically downloaded one is used (CPU build; Metal-enabled on macOS). Set this to use a GPU build such as CUDA. Because it points to an executable, it can only be set in user settings (remote settings when working remotely).
config.server.modelPath: Path to the model (GGUF) used in `managed` mode. If empty, the model selected in `interlinear.server.model` is used. Can only be set in user settings (remote settings when working remotely).
config.endpoint: URL of the llama-server used when `interlinear.server.mode` is `external`. To use a server on the host from a Dev Container, use something like `http://host.docker.internal:18080`.
config.targetLanguage: Output language (ISO 639-1 code, e.g. ja, en, zh, ko). If empty, follows the VS Code display language (ja for Japanese, en otherwise).
config.sourceLanguage: Input language. If empty, the model detects it.
config.form: Writing style when translating into Japanese.
config.useContext: Pass the file name and the line of code following a comment to the model as reference for translation.
config.glossary: Glossary. Specify terms whose translation should be fixed as `{ "source": "term", "target": "translation" }`.
config.prefetch: Translate comments visible on screen in advance.
config.maxConcurrentRequests: Number of translation requests sent at the same time. Set it to the same value as llama-server's `--parallel` (`-np`).
